Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study focuses on the biochemical characterization of a protease (AM0627) and its mutants. The proteomics (MS) part of the study is used to analyze the cleavage products (O-glycopeptides) to determine how mutations in the enzyme's S1 subsite alter its substrate preference.
